newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won closes weaker on yen's drop vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won closes weaker on yen's drop vs dlr.

text.p: The won closed weaker against the dollar on Wednesday as the Japanese yen's drop depressed sentiment for the local currency, dealers said.
They said smaller-than-expected dollar supply from exporters was also a factor impacting the market.
The won ended at 892.00, down from Tuesday's closing at 891.70. It opened at an intraday low of 892.80 and touched a high of 891.80.
"The won is likely to fall further as exporter deals were smaller than expected and due to the yen's weakness," said a foreign bank dealer.
But dealers said the won's drop could be limited because any sharp drop is expected to spark profit-taking dollar selling.
They forecast the won's base mid-rate for Thursday at 892.00 won, compared with Wednesday's 891.70.
